name: Extreme Capacity Booster
description: This xApp aggressively maximizes total network throughput. It increases bandwidth allocation and transmit power for all cells. It prioritizes users with the highest SINR in each cell. It focuses on peak capacity rather than fairness or energy efficiency. It may increase interference and overall power consumption.

control_parameters.semantic: Scale the available PRBs per cell to increase spectral resources.
Increase cell transmit power to boost SINR and data rate.
Select the highest SINR user per cell for throughput maximization.
Uniform UE weights. No fairness adjustment.
